sharding.descriptor_canonicalization: UTF8 JSON sorted keys compact; sort descriptor bytes; leaf=SHA256(descriptor_bytes); root=SHA256(concat(sorted leaf digests))
sharding.resume: each shard writes temporary receipt and artifacts, validates counts+roots, fsync, then atomic rename; completed valid shards are never recomputed

requirements: minimal DEV bytes materialized and exact-prefix SHA verified

GA1_EVENT_MASK_ENUMERATION_AND_DEDUPE.work: causally compute every signal/event mask on DEV; exact SHA-256 mask dedupe inside and across shards; preserve alias map and canonical representative
GA1_EVENT_MASK_ENUMERATION_AND_DEDUPE.canonical_representative: lexicographically smallest SIGNAL_CONFIG_ID among exact-identical event masks
GA1_EVENT_MASK_ENUMERATION_AND_DEDUPE.multiplicity_accounting: N_TESTS begins from distinct semantic/event-mask hypotheses, not raw aliases

GA2_SIGNAL_ALPHA_SCORING.reason: test signal alpha without allowing management optimization to create/rescue the edge
GA2_SIGNAL_ALPHA_SCORING.multiplicity: family-aware omnibus/permutation plus BH/BY/Deflated-Sharpe/White-SPA as applicable; exact method preregistered before reading GA2 outputs
GA2_SIGNAL_ALPHA_SCORING.selection_rule: no max-PF winner picking; all configurations satisfying frozen Gate A and multiplicity criteria advance

GA3_MANAGEMENT_OVERLAY_SWEEP.scope: all 3,710 frozen management profiles applied exhaustively to every GA2 signal survivor
GA3_MANAGEMENT_OVERLAY_SWEEP.prohibition: management overlay cannot rescue a signal that failed GA2
GA3_MANAGEMENT_OVERLAY_SWEEP.identity: management variants remain profiles of the same signal alpha, not independent alpha modules

GA4_EXECUTION_AND_STRESS.selection_use: stress can reject or downgrade; diagnostic REMOVE_BEST_TRADES may not rescue

anti_explosion_rule.forbidden: blind Cartesian economic scoring of 48,280,320 signals x 3,710 management x 3 execution x 7 stress before signal evidence
anti_explosion_rule.scientific_reason: management/execution/stress are overlays, not independent causal alpha; crossing all of them before signal evidence inflates multiplicity and wastes compute without adding causal coverage
